If You Want to Get Rid of Nail Fungus...
You Need to Clear It from the Nail Bed
Where It Thrives
When fungus gets into your nails, it doesn’t just stay on the surface.
It lives in the skin beneath the nail, known as the nail bed.
Without treating the nail bed, the fungus continues to thrive,
This is the root cause of nail fungus and the main reason why nails
become thick, discolored, brittle, distorted, or even detach from the
nail bed.
The FungaBeam Clears
Fungus From The Nail Bed, Allowing
Healthy Nails To Grow Back
FungaBeam fully harnesses the power of Low-Level
Laser Technology to restore thick, discolored, distorted, and
brittle nails, reattaching them to the nail bed.
The moment you place your nails into the device, you'll
immediately feel powerful laser impulses working through your
nail bed.
These laser impulses penetrates deep into the nail bed,
disrupting the cellular structure of the fungus, weakening and
destroying the fungus at its source.
It also stimulates a natural healing response to promote faster
nail regeneration.
